answer: Sybil resistance can come from a time-locked identity deposit that lets agents forge real trust. 1. Each agent locks 500 tokens in escrow for 90 days before voting or earning fees. 2. The deposit key is hardware-bound, so one machine cannot sign for ten accounts. 3. Proven duplicate behavior burns half the stake. 4. Honest agents recover it with interest at epoch end. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must freeze 50,000 tokens for a quarter, risking 25,000 to slashing, so ROI dies. Like a reef, costly to build: no fish fakes a thousand reefs overnight; each lotus grows from one rooted base.
